content_sections.heading: HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: All 6 posts are in the Unreserved (UR) category. The number of vacancies is provisional and may be increased or decreased based on actual requirement. Candidates can apply for more than one post code if they meet the eligibility for each, though HSFC reserves the right to conduct interviews for two or more posts simultaneously as per administrative need. Where discipline names overlap (as in Post Codes 05 and 06), candidates should apply only against the post code matching their essential and pre-requisite qualification.

content_sections.heading: HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is assessed as on the crucial date of 30.08.2026. Only candidates who hold the required qualification by this date can apply. Additional qualification conditions: The Ph.D. and Master's/Bachelor's qualification must be from a recognized university/institute. Candidates with degrees from foreign universities must submit an equivalency certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) at the time of interview. The ME/M.Tech/MS/MSc/BE/B.Tech/BSc/BS-MS qualification must have been completed within the stipulated duration prescribed by the university. Candidates who completed a professional course through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible. Where CGPA is converted to a percentage, or vice versa, ISRO's own eligibility criteria apply; conversion of CGPA to percentage using a university formula is not permitted to determine eligibility, and rounding-off of marks is not allowed. The upper age limit for all post codes (01 to 06) is 35 years as on the crucial date, 30.08.2026. Serving Central Government employees, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen are eligible for age relaxation as per extant Government of India rules. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed in Level-11 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 67,700 – Rs. 2,08,700), with approximate gross emoluments of Rs. 67,700 per month plus admissible allowances. In addition to Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Transport Allowance are payable as per extant rules. Employees are covered under the National Pension System/Unified Pension Scheme, along with medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidized canteen, quarters facility (in lieu of HRA), Leave Travel Concession, Group Insurance and House Building Advance, as admissible under DOS/Central Government orders.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the ISRO Live Register portal at www.isro.gov.in and go to the "Career" tab. Register or update your existing registration on the Live Register portal. Fill in the online application form carefully, entering correct details in all mandatory (*) fields. Apply only against the post code matching your essential and pre-requisite qualification. Upload the required photo, signature and qualification certificates as specified. Submit the application on or before 30.08.2026 (1700 hrs) and take a printout of the submitted application for future reference. Candidates registered under the National Career Service (NCS) portal and meeting the eligibility conditions may also visit the ISRO website and follow the same application procedure.

content_sections.heading: HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Apply Online
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only online through the ISRO Live Register portal; physical/postal applications are not entertained. No documents need to be sent by post or email.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Apply Online
content_sections.text: Applications submitted without complete information, photo, signature or the required documents will be summarily rejected. Selfies, black-and-white photos, or blurred images are not accepted; the photo must show a frontal view of the full face against a plain/white background.

faq.question: Q1. What is HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC), ISRO to fill 6 Scientist/Engineer 'SD' posts in Level-11 of the Pay Matrix, across six bio-science and biomedical engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies in total, one each under Post Codes 01 to 06, all in the Unreserved (UR) category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 30.08.2026 at 1700 hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in the specified discipline for the relevant post code, along with the pre-requisite Master's and Bachelor's qualification detailed in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 30.08.2026, with relaxation for Central Government employees, PwBD candidates and Ex-Servicemen as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for these posts.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the ISRO Live Register portal (www.isro.gov.in, under the Career tab) on or before 30.08.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted through initial screening of online applications, and final selection is based solely on performance in the Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in Level-11 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 67,700 – Rs. 2,08,700), with approximate gross emoluments of Rs. 67,700 per month plus allowances.
